complaint_text: I am absolutely furious with how my claim has been handled. I filed my claim over three weeks ago after my car was damaged in a parking lot hit and run. I uploaded all the photos you asked for, filed the police report, did everything right. And now I get a letter saying my claim is DENIED because you say I only have liability coverage and this isn't covered. I have been a customer for six years and I have NEVER had a claim before. Nobody ever explained to me that a hit and run in a parking lot wouldn't be covered. I feel completely misled. I want this decision reviewed immediately. If this isn't resolved I will be filing a complaint with the Florida Department of Insurance and consulting with an attorney. I expect a call back from a supervisor within 24 hours.
denial_reason_on_file: Coverage type liability_only does not include comprehensive or collision coverage for at-fault or unidentified party incidents
